page.layout: One page of text, main column right of centre; running head centred at top; page number top right; narrow partial column of notes at the left margin (cut by the gutter), with fragments of marginal notes.

main_text.l: Multiplica 40 per 7, facilus erit 280, qui per 70
divisus, exhibet 4, seu uncias duas, quæsitum panis ponas.
Hic iterum quo molæ plures fuerint, eo minori
tempore datam tritici copiam molent. Quare proportio reciproce
reos utendos ab amico sumens, e-
ma seruare debeat, ut mutui æqua-

page.notes: Left-margin fragments are partial notes cut by the gutter (e.g. "eft:", "fa-", "tri-", "ali-", "eli-", "lem", "ex 12", "Unde", "à pri", "quos", "um 2", "eodem", "eò pa", "panis", "is Res", "gulam"); they are too incomplete to read reliably and are not transcribed. Running head reads "PARS II." with the page number 115 at top right. Diagram-like fractions in the arithmetic are approximate.
